All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AircraftCarrier
Aircraft carrier: occupies 4 cells.
Board
A 10x10 board.
Board3DView
3D visual representation of a Board.
BoardListener
Observer pattern: whoever implements this interface (typically a JavaFX view controller) is notified every time a Board cell changes state, without the model knowing anything about JavaFX.
Cell
A board cell.
CellState
State a board cell can be in at any point during the game.
Coordinate
Represents a (row, column) position within the 10x10 board.
Destroyer
Destroyer: occupies 2 cells.
Fleet
Represents a player's whole fleet (10 ships).
Frigate
Frigate: occupies 1 cell.
GameClock
Independent thread that works as the game's stopwatch: every second it updates (via Platform.runLater(java.lang.Runnable)) a Label with the time elapsed since the shooting turns started.
GameController
Orchestrates the whole game: placement phase (HU-1), human/machine shooting turns (HU-2/HU-4), enemy board verification (HU-3), and victory detection.
GamePersistenceManager
Single access point for game persistence.
GamePhase
Phase the game is currently in.
GameSession
Holds session data that needs to be passed from the start screen (StartController) to the game board (GameController) without coupling the two controllers to each other.
GameState
Serializable snapshot of everything needed to resume the game: the two full boards (with fleets, cells, and hits already applied) and the turn/phase/placement state of GameController.
GameSummary
Human-readable game summary (nickname and count of sunk ships per side).
GameTurn
Whose turn it is to fire.
HullMeshBuilder
Generates a faceted "low poly" ship hull segment (no images, only flat faces) as a hand-built TriangleMesh: a "tube" with a pentagonal cross-section (V-shaped keel, sides opening up toward the deck) between two rings, one at each end of the segment.
HumanPlayer
Human player.
HuntTargetShootingStrategy
"Hunt and finish" strategy: if there is any cell in the HIT state (a damaged ship that isn't sunk yet), it fires at random among the neighboring cells (up/down/left/right) that haven't been fired at yet, to try to sink that ship before exploring further.
InvalidPlacementException
Checked exception: thrown when trying to place a ship outside the board or overlapping another ship that is already placed.
InvalidShotException
Unchecked exception: thrown when firing at a coordinate outside the board or one that was already fired at before (water, hit, or sunk).
MachinePlayer
Machine player.
Main
Entry point for the Battleship application.
MainController
Controller for the main view (FXML).
Orientation
Direction a ship extends from the cell the player clicks on (that cell is always the bow).
PersistenceAdapter<T>
Common port (Adapter pattern) the rest of the application uses to save and load data, without knowing the actual I/O mechanism behind it.
PersistenceException
Checked exception: wraps any read/write failure when saving or loading the game state (serializable files or plain text files).
PlainTextSummaryAdapter
Adapter (Adapter pattern) that exposes saving the game summary (nickname and sunk ships) through PersistenceAdapter, delegating to line-by-line plain text reading/writing (key=value).
Player
A player in the game (human or machine).
RandomFleetPlacer
Places a complete fleet of 10 ships on a board at random, respecting HU-1's rules (no overlap, within the board).
RandomShootingStrategy
Random shooting strategy: picks at random among the cells that have not been fired at yet.
SerializedStateAdapter
Adapter (Adapter pattern) that exposes saving the boards' state through PersistenceAdapter, delegating to Java's native serialization API (ObjectOutputStream / ObjectInputStream).
Ship
Represents a ship in the fleet.
ShipFactory
Factory Method pattern: centralizes creating Ship instances based on ShipType, avoiding an instantiation switch/if-else scattered throughout the fleet placement code.
ShipType
Ship types defined by the assignment, with the size (number of cells it occupies) and how many units of it each fleet has.
ShootingStrategy
Strategy pattern: defines how the machine chooses its next shooting coordinate.
Shot
Immutable record of a shot already taken: where, and with what result.
ShotResult
Immediate result of firing at a coordinate on the board.
SoundManager
Single point for the background music and the short sound effects (button hover/click) of the whole application.
StartController
Controller for the start screen (FXML): asks for the player's nickname and offers "Play" (new game) or "Continue" (resumes the last saved game, see GamePersistenceManager).
Submarine
Submarine: occupies 3 cells.
